title: Balia'mah Ruins

[[Image:Balia'mah Ruins.jpg|thumb|300px|Balia'mah Ruins]]
'''Balia'mah Ruins''' are ancient [[Jungle troll|troll]] ruins found in [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. They are currently inhabited by the [[Skullsplitter tribe|Skullsplitter]] trolls. They are located east-southeast of [[Grom'gol Base Camp]] on the east side of the river and south-west of [[Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound]].
